test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer - General Awareness (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Select the INCORRECT pair of autobiographies and their respective authors.

options.text: Playing It My Way - MS Dhoni
Dreams from My Father - Barack Obama
Wings of Fire - Dr APJ Abdul Kalam

solution:
The correct answer is __**Playing It My Way - MS Dhoni**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Playing It My Way** is an autobiography of **Sachin Tendulkar**, not MS Dhoni.
 
• MS Dhoni has not authored any autobiography as of the latest information available.
 
• **Dreams from My Father** is authored by **Barack Obama**.
 
• **Wings of Fire** is an autobiography of **Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam**.
 
• **Moonwalk** is an autobiography of **Michael Jackson**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Autobiography**:

 
 
• An autobiography is a self-written account of the life of oneself.
 
• It provides personal insights and firsthand experiences of the author.
 
• Famous autobiographies include "The Story of My Experiments with Truth" by Mahatma Gandhi and "Long Walk to Freedom" by Nelson Mandela.
 
 
 
• **MS Dhoni**:
 
 
• MS Dhoni is a renowned Indian cricketer, known for his captaincy and wicketkeeping.
 
• He led India to victory in the 2007 ICC T20 World Cup, the 2011 ICC Cricket World Cup, and the 2013 ICC Champions Trophy.
 
• He is considered one of the greatest finishers in limited-overs cricket.
 
 
 
• **Sachin Tendulkar**:
 
 
• Sachin Tendulkar is a legendary Indian cricketer widely regarded as one of the greatest batsmen in the history of cricket.
 
• He has numerous records to his name, including the most runs in international cricket.
 
• His autobiography "Playing It My Way" provides an in-depth look at his cricketing journey and personal life.
 
 
 
• **Barack Obama**:
 
 
• Barack Obama served as the 44th President of the United States from 2009 to 2017.
 
• His autobiography "Dreams from My Father" explores his early life, family background, and personal journey.
 
• Obama is also the author of "The Audacity of Hope" and "A Promised Land."
